label: development diagnostics after kcnl1 was scored; not a pre-registered run, no bar applies
notes: ca_lag: Jaxley Ca pool takes i_ca at the previous step's v and KCNL sees the updated pool (NEURON's nrn_cur/nrn_state order; mechanisms register alphabetically, caintra1 before kcnl). Cuts the mismatch 4-6x but M stays 40x over the 0.01 mV bar; the residual grows during the step and peaks in the far compartment.

K0 is not a calcium carryover: resetting caintra1.calcium leaves it unchanged. Inferred cause: unc2 registers after slo1unc2/slo2unc2, so their INITIAL reads UNC-2 gates left from the previous run through the new per-segment pointer, while the published-mods harness resets the GLOBAL copies to 0. Sweep 0 is identical, later sweeps differ.
Both schemes at dt 0.4 ms are 1.7-2.2 mV RMS from the dt 0.01 ms solution on this thin cable with KCNL at 1e-3 S/cm2 (guessed test density), so the time step itself is a 2 mV-scale error here.
